lots.title: Provision of Asbestos Surveys Services
lots.description: Single-lot Draft Terms & Conditions template (Part 1 Form of Contract, Part 2 General Terms & Conditions, Part 3 Special Conditions — TUPE) governing the supply of Asbestos Surveys services in London Borough of Bexley Council Buildings by an appointed Contractor. The template was drafted for a contract period 1 September 2020 to 31 August 2024 and is being reused as the draft T&Cs for Lot 3 of Framework 6278. The substantive asbestos service specification, pricing schedule, ITT and Contractor proposal are referenced as Schedules 1–4 but are not present in the body of this extracted document (header placeholders only).
requirements: Contractor shall supply the Services during the Contract Period in accordance with the Council's requirements as set out in the Specification, the Code of Conduct at Appendix D to the ITT and the provisions of the Contract (Clause B1.1).

Contractor shall comply with the Quality Standards, and where applicable maintain accreditation with the relevant Quality Standards authorisation body; unspecified standards shall be agreed with the Council prior to supply and shall follow the Law and Good Industry Practice (Clause B3.1).

All Staff supplying the Services must possess the qualifications, skills and experience set out in the Specification; staff must wear appropriate uniform/safety clothing at all times on site (Clause B4.2).

Contractor shall register with the Disclosure and Barring Service and, where required by the Specification, carry out DBS criminal records checks on relevant staff, with rechecks at least every three years; a DBS policy and staff-check register shall be provided to the Council (Clauses B4.9, B4.11–B4.14).

Contractor shall ensure that chemicals, substances and materials used in the Services comply with manufacturer instructions, the Specification, HSE/Environment Agency approvals, and any relevant British or European standard (Clause D6.2).

Contractor shall comply with the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974 and all applicable health & safety law, orders, regulations and codes of practice including those referred to in the Specification (Clause D6.7).

Contractor shall maintain public/third-party liability and product liability insurance of at least £5,000,000 per claim (rising to £10,000,000 per claim where the Contractor employs 100 or more people), employer's liability of at least £5,000,000 per incident, and, where required by the nature of the services, professional indemnity insurance of at least £2,000,000 per incident (Clause G1.7).
Contractor shall maintain professional indemnity insurance of not less than £2,000,000 per claim, continuing for at least six years after expiry or termination of the Contract (Clause G2).

Contractor shall provide records of and Management Reports summarising the KPIs set out in Appendix E to the Invitation to Tender, and meet with the Authorised Officer at the frequency specified in the Specification (Clauses F5.3, F7.1–F7.2).

Processing of Personal Data shall be limited to what is authorised in Schedule 1; Contractor acts as Processor (unless Schedule 1 states otherwise) and shall comply with the Data Protection Legislation and GDPR Joint Controller arrangements where applicable (Clauses E1.1, E1.15).

Contractor shall preserve the integrity of Council Data, prevent corruption/loss, and use the latest industry-accepted anti-virus definitions/software on any Contractor ICT system that interfaces with the Council's ICT systems (Clauses E1A.4, E1A.9).
Sub-contractors must be paid undisputed sums within 30 days of a valid invoice; the Council may publish compliance with this obligation (Clause C2.6).

Contract period: commences on the Commencement Date and expires on the date specified in the Form of Contract / Specification; Council may extend under Clause F8; Contract Price is fixed for the initial Contract Period subject to Clause C4 (Clauses A2, C1.1, C4.1).

warnings.message: Schedule 1 (Specification) is referenced throughout (Clauses 1.2(d), B1.1, B3.2, B4.2, B4.11, D6.2, D6.7, F3.1, F9.2) but the extracted markdown contains only the header placeholder 'SCHEDULE 1 / SPECIFICATION' with no body. Asbestos-specific survey scope, standards (e.g., HSG264, UKAS ISO/IEC 17020/17025 accreditation, BOHS P402/P404/P405 competency, CAR 2012 compliance) are therefore unavailable from this document. Detailed product requirements should be sourced from the actual Specification schedule.

Schedule 2 (Pricing Schedule) is referenced (Clauses 1.2(e), C1.1, C2.2, A1.1 'Pricing Schedule' definition) but only the header placeholder is present in the extracted markdown. Contract Price, unit rates and rate card cannot be derived from this document.

Schedule 3 (The Council's Invitation to Tender) and its appendices (notably Appendix D — Code of Conduct, Appendix E — KPIs / Service Credits table) are referenced throughout (Clauses B1.1, F5.1–F5.4, F7.1) but are not included in the extracted markdown. Award / evaluation criteria and explicit KPI weightings cannot be derived from this document.
Schedule 4 (The Contractor's Tender) is a placeholder — not yet populated at draft-T&Cs stage. No product_requirement_seeds derivable from the Contractor's tender content.

No CPV codes appear in the body of this draft T&Cs document. The notice-level CPV codes (50700000-2 Repair and maintenance services of building installations; 50750000-7 Lift-maintenance services; 71315000-9 Building services) cover the framework but are not lot-specific and do not enumerate an asbestos-specific CPV (e.g., 90650000-8 Asbestos removal services, 71317100-4 Asbestos protection services). cpv_codes deliberately left empty on the lot — fabricating asbestos CPVs without textual evidence would violate evidence grounding.
